sources.note: Reverse engineering help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: Naming rules can skip configured table and column name prefixes and suffixes (comma-separated).
claims.supports: prefixes and suffixes to skip for table names and column names; comma-separated

claims.statement: A reserved-keyword field suffix is appended when a column name clashes with a Java keyword (class -> classField).
claims.supports: Reserved keyword field suffix ... class becomes classField

claims.statement: A setting converts table names to singular class names (users -> User).
claims.supports: Convert table names to singular form for class names

claims.statement: A setting replaces ORM references with basic attributes (customer_id -> Long customerId).
claims.supports: Replace ORM references with basic attributes
